_classes.name: Month offsets dated as 30-day blocks
_classes.rule: deadline_kind in (days_after_effective, days_after_enactment) and deadline_text matches '(\d+|one..thirty-six) months' and deadline_date != base date + N calendar months (base = effective_date or enactment_date)

_classes.name: Real duty dropped by designation_no_actor (named government subject with a verb)
_classes.rule: dropped rule == designation_no_actor and quote matches '(director of the budget|commissioner|department|...|village)[^.;]{0,80}(shall|will|must|may|is authorized|is directed)' (also: the gate ignores 'will' as a duty verb)

_classes.name: Distinct duty dropped as deadline_split
_classes.rule: dropped rule == deadline_split and quote has no deadline phrase (within|no later than|not later than|on or before|by <month>|days|months|years after|prior to)

_classes.name: Generic role noun stored as a named body
_classes.rule: agency_source == named_body and agency matches 'appointing authorit|governing bod|legislative bod|chief executive officer|municipal corporation|political subdivision|^the agency$'

_classes.name: BOCES split between 'School districts' and 'BOCES' agency labels
_classes.rule: actor_raw matches 'cooperative educational|boces' and agency == 'School districts' (13 other BOCES records use agency 'BOCES'); needs a convention decision, scored correct here

_classes.name: Under-extraction of secondary powers/duties in long free-standing special acts (fee CPI increases, implementation powers, issue-by-event duties, extend-geography power)
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule; proxy for triage: laws whose packet text has >= 2x more 'may|shall|authorized' clauses in new matter than stored records

_classes.name: Changed existing duty (amended section) stored extends_existing false
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule without the packet: extends_existing false where the quote mixes reprinted and braced text in an 'is amended to read' section

_classes.name: Deletion that widens a power not recorded / budget-bill reallocation authority not recorded
